title: Correction movement evidence-inclusion verification
decision: Implement discovery Option A: a pure projection over canonical FOOD-006V verified provenance. Fresh FOOD-006P recorded-balance composition already preserves bounded physical-movement provenance as exact movementId plus evidenceSequence within each exact batch, so no additional database reader is required.
eligibility: FOOD-006V verified is eligible for correction movement inclusion verification.
FOOD-006V no-correction-required returns no-correction-required without any inclusion claim.
FOOD-006V invalid, ineligible, stale, not-found and storage-failure are ineligible.
Malformed or tampered FOOD-006V verified/no-correction provenance returns invalid.
verification: Revalidate the FOOD-006T candidate bundle from FOOD-006V.
Require the FOOD-006V original reconciliation to exactly equal canonical correction provenance.
Recompute canonical FOOD-006R from the fresh validated recorded-balance value and the exact historical FOOD-006Q observation.
Require the supplied FOOD-006V bookkeeping reconciliation to equal that canonical recomputation.
Use the fresh validated FOOD-006P recorded-balance composition already retained by FOOD-006V.
Index bounded movement provenance by exact movement identity.
Require every correction movement ID to exist.
Require each correction movement reference to occur on the exact candidate batch.
Require each correction movement evidenceSequence to be less than or equal to the validated exact-SKU cutoff.
Do not require correction evidence sequences to be consecutive.
Do not require correction movements to be the only evidence in the generation.
Allow unrelated exact-SKU evidence to interleave.
Do not require the authoritative head to advance for idempotent already-present retries.

outcomes.verified: Every canonical correction movement is represented in the exact bounded recorded-balance composition at or before the validated cutoff and on its exact batch.
outcomes.missing-evidence: One or more canonical correction movement identities are absent from the fresh bounded composition; all found and missing identities are exposed without claiming full inclusion.
outcomes.no-correction-required: No correction movement inclusion proof is required because upstream reconciliation was agreement.
outcomes.ineligible: The upstream FOOD-006V result is not a verified/no-correction result.
outcomes.invalid: Supplied provenance or bounded evidence violates canonical invariants.

safeClaim: Every canonical correction movement from the completed FOOD-006U bundle is represented by exact-SKU inventory evidence at or before the authoritative cutoff used by the validated post-correction recorded balance.
doesNotEstablish: truth or completeness of the historical physical count
